description: Dynamic Stability Control, CAF [DSC_CT02M]. Block 3000 (first part, up to Bremsscheibe_vorne) is named; remaining blocks only have block names. Activation condition of block 3000: F020 true, F030 true.
source: E-Sys CAF tree (user supplied screenshots). Block sizes (hex) match the live read of ECU 0x29 with CAF 005_000_000: 3000=20 3001=10 3002=06 3003=08 3004=28 3006=5C 3008=14 300C=02 300D=06 300E=08 300F=84. Block 3000 parameter order/values match the live read for 3000/0..18.

values.06: F82 GTS (special model, crit 2919, build before 07/2017)

Not confirmed in E-Sys; the GTS vs CS split by build date (1707) is an inference.
